hooks.name: venom-session-start
hooks.description: Venom: find the project and task before the first reply

action.command: f=.kiro/hooks/venom/venom-hook.sh; [ -f "$f" ] || f="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)/$f"; [ -f "$f" ] && VENOM_HOOK_FORMAT=text sh "$f" session-start || true

hooks.name: venom-pre-compaction
hooks.description: Venom: keep task refs and unlogged decisions in the summary

action.command: f=.kiro/hooks/venom/venom-hook.sh; [ -f "$f" ] || f="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)/$f"; [ -f "$f" ] && VENOM_HOOK_FORMAT=text sh "$f" pre-compact || true

hooks.name: venom-post-compaction
hooks.description: Venom: re-read the task after compaction

action.command: f=.kiro/hooks/venom/venom-hook.sh; [ -f "$f" ] || f="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)/$f"; [ -f "$f" ] && VENOM_HOOK_FORMAT=text sh "$f" compacted || true

hooks.name: venom-milestone
hooks.description: Venom: log the outcome after a commit, push, PR, merge, release or deploy

action.command: f=.kiro/hooks/venom/venom-hook.sh; [ -f "$f" ] || f="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)/$f"; [ -f "$f" ] && VENOM_HOOK_FORMAT=text sh "$f" post-tool || true

hooks.name: venom-log-clears-stop
hooks.description: Venom: a log call clears the pending end-of-turn question

action.command: f=.kiro/hooks/venom/venom-hook.sh; [ -f "$f" ] || f="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)/$f"; [ -f "$f" ] && VENOM_HOOK_FORMAT=text sh "$f" post-tool || true

hooks.name: venom-stop
hooks.description: Venom: ask once to log an outcome nothing was logged for

action.command: f=.kiro/hooks/venom/venom-hook.sh; [ -f "$f" ] || f="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)/$f"; [ -f "$f" ] && VENOM_HOOK_FORMAT=text sh "$f" stop || true
